_readme: Source-grounded M2 scenarios built from data/siis_responses.json (query + SIIS article title). expected_catalog_ids is intentionally empty until manually reviewed; no ground truth is invented.

scenarios.query: My Samsung A115G tablet screen flashes and then goes completely blank whenever I tap to open an email in Gmail, and after it works for a short time it goes blank again.
scenarios.source_title: Email server not responding on Samsung phone or tablet

scenarios.query: My Galaxy S22 screen turns completely blank or white and no text appears when I search for a stock price or use the Smart Tutor app, and it happens with other apps too.
scenarios.source_title: Blank or black display on a Samsung phone or tablet

scenarios.query: My Galaxy Z Flip 7 screen went completely black, so I can't see or interact with the phone, and I'm unable to use Smart Switch or any other method to transfer my data.
scenarios.source_title: Some things to check first

scenarios.query: My Samsung Galaxy A15/A16 screen suddenly went completely black on its own after about a month of use. It doesn't display anything, even when I try to turn it on.
scenarios.source_title: Blank or black display on a Samsung phone or tablet

scenarios.query: My Galaxy tablet screen stays completely blank when I try to use Smart Switch to scan the QR code for transferring data from my Galaxy S25 phone, so the transfer can't proceed.
scenarios.source_title: Transfer Secure folder with Smart Switch

scenarios.query: My tablet's screen stays dark and only three app icons are lit while the rest are dark and won't open, so nothing loads on the screen and I can't use the device.
scenarios.source_title: Use Multi window and App pairs on your Galaxy phone or tablet

scenarios.query: My new Samsung phone's main screen stays small and doesn't fill the whole display; I can't make it expand to full size and I've never seen this before.
scenarios.source_title: Screen mirroring to your Samsung TV

scenarios.query: My Galaxy Flip 7 inner screen stopped working by itself; it shows no image and doesn't respond to touch, while the outer cover screen still works.

scenarios.query: My Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 6 screen flickers and goes blank whenever I open it, so I can't see anything or access the settings, which stops me from using the phone.

scenarios.query: My Galaxy Flip 6 screen is half black—one side of the display is completely dark while the other side works fine, so I can't access the device normally.

scenarios.query: My Galaxy S25 has a floating circle that constantly hovers on my screen and gives me quick shortcuts to recent apps, home, back, screen off, volume control, and more; I want to remove it.

scenarios.query: My Galaxy S22 screen stays blank and doesn't show any activation message or anything else when I turn it on after the carrier deactivated the old phone.
